district.name: Dakshina Kannada
district.geographic_features: Bounded by Western Ghats in the east and Arabian Sea in the west, traversed by Netravathi and Gurupura rivers.
district.climate: Tropical monsoon climate with heavy rainfall from June to September.

records.title: Mangaluru Maritime & Port History
records.description: Historical spice trading port connecting coastal Karnataka with the Persian Gulf, Rome, and East Africa.

records.title: Yakshagana - Tenku Thittu Style
records.description: The vibrant southern school of Yakshagana theatre, celebrated for vigorous dance steps, fast-paced rhythm, and elaborate traditional costumes.

records.title: Kadri Manjunatha Temple
records.description: An ancient 10th-century temple featuring Lokeshwara bronze statue and Vijayanagara architectural elements.

places.name: Kadri Manjunatha Temple & Hills
places.description: Historic hill temple complex with ancient water ponds (Kandri/Kadri) and Buddhist-Hindu syncretic art heritage.

places.name: St. Aloysius Chapel
places.description: Renowned 19th-century chapel featuring breathtaking interior ceiling paintings and frescoes by Italian Jesuit artist Antonio Moscheni.

places.name: Panambur Beach
places.description: One of India's best-managed golden sand beaches known for the annual International Kite Festival and stunning Arabian Sea sunsets.
